checklist.notes: Past-perfect timelines and controlled weak forms directly address past relationships and connected speech, with narrative sequence supporting the communicative purpose.
The lesson supplies rule, timeline, annotated narrative, controlled-to-fluent pronunciation practice, planning, recording, and a diagnostic retry check.
Past perfect and weak forms are introduced only after the reconstructed narrative, past-tense, sentence-stress, word-stress, syllable, and phoneme prerequisites.
The core earlier-past contrast is clear; the second model’s arrow mapping could be made more explicit for independent checking.
One grammar relationship and one connected-speech process, both practiced in the same short narrative, fit the declared 35 minutes.
The staged careful-to-reduced production and preservation of content words provide accessible support without assuming a uniform Vietnamese learner profile.
Every section contributes to a final four-event narrative that coordinates earlier-past marking with reduced unstressed function words.

findings.description: In the second model, had packed has an explicit later point, but “Her friend had already bought the tickets” does not state its later reference point. The instruction to draw arrows to “went/arrived” leaves the solo learner to infer which later event anchors had bought.
findings.recommendation: State the anchor explicitly—for example, “By the time Mina arrived, her friend had already bought the tickets”—and specify the intended arrow for each past-perfect event.

methods: Inspected the lesson against its reconstructed, hash-matched M5 teaching payload and confirmed that no external source payload was supplied.

copyright_originality_check.scope_limitations: Closed-corpus review of the ten supplied lessons plus their exact M5/request/audit context only; no Internet-wide search, external proprietary corpus, legal opinion, or provider receipt was available.

limitations: This is an independent AI pedagogical review for development evidence only; it is not human review, release approval, certification, or publication authorization.
The governing M5 snapshot retains DRAFT taxonomy and OUTLINE_ONLY curriculum records and is limited to the development lane.

No audio was supplied, so no acoustic, listening-performance, or pronunciation-performance review was performed.
Originality checking was closed-corpus and artifact-bound; no web-wide plagiarism search, external corpus comparison, or legal determination was performed.
Generation provider provenance was not independently established; UNKNOWN is retained rather than inferred.
Generator reasoning, self-assessment, and prior review records were not inspected.
